checks.name: Run directory artifact presence
checks.recommended_action: No action required; optional artifacts can improve coverage depth.

checks.name: Runtime-sensitive rule evidence
checks.recommended_action: No runtime evidence found; fail-closed posture preserved as expected.

checks.name: Vendor token heuristic scan
checks.recommended_action: No vendor-token matches detected by heuristic scan.

checks.name: Downstream derivation risk surfacing
checks.recommended_action: No derivation warnings detected in existing audit artifacts.

checks.name: Build/gate/scoring status summary
checks.recommended_action: No action; summary artifacts indicate non-failing static governance state.

rule_mapping.rule_summary: Use upstream-first LE architecture: codec aggregate driver + SoundWire transport split + shared helper libraries.
rule_mapping.notes: Architecture reuse is inferred via artifact/governance context, not structural AST validation.

rule_mapping.rule_summary: Use LA as content donor and LE as structure/reference pattern; never copy LA structure verbatim.
rule_mapping.notes: Downstream derivation warnings are surfaced from verifier/anti-copy artifacts.

rule_mapping.rule_summary: Keep LE target files hidden until scoring/gate stage in controlled reconstruction experiments.
Require multi-file lineage coverage for converted codec, SDW, and header files.
rule_mapping.notes: Lineage artifact presence and entry inference are implemented.

rule_mapping.rule_summary: Preserve SoundWire RX/TX split structure in LE style and treat identity tuple finalization as runtime-evidence gated.
rule_mapping.notes: Runtime evidence gating and fail-closed posture checks are implemented; SDW semantics are not re-verified.

rule_mapping.rule_summary: Use LE regmap/regcache lifecycle patterns but keep paging/controller assumptions fail-closed until runtime traces.
rule_mapping.notes: Runtime-sensitive fail-closed check is present; regmap lifecycle correctness is not deep-inspected.

rule_mapping.rule_summary: Map DAPM widgets/routes/controls with topology evidence and penalize name-only cloning.
rule_mapping.notes: Derivation risk surfacing is implemented; DAPM topology mapping quality is not recomputed.

rule_mapping.rule_summary: Reuse MBHC/Class-H shared libraries while keeping codec-specific Class-H base/version decisions fail-closed.
rule_mapping.notes: Runtime-sensitive fail-closed checks cover MBHC/Class-H gating only at artifact level.

rule_mapping.rule_summary: Reject reset-in-hw_params and ad-hoc runtime recovery workarounds in conversion outputs.
rule_mapping.notes: Runtime claim and heuristic scans may catch workaround language but do not parse semantics fully.

rule_mapping.rule_summary: Enforce vendor include/API elimination with explicit replacement mapping to LE frameworks.
rule_mapping.notes: Vendor-token heuristic scan is implemented, not a full semantic API-elimination proof.

rule_mapping.rule_summary: Run anti-copy/anti-derivation checks and treat downstream warning findings as governance risk.
rule_mapping.notes: Existing derivation/downstream reuse warnings are surfaced from verifier/anti-copy artifacts.

rule_mapping.rule_summary: Separate DTS/schema normalization from runtime proof; keep evidence checklists explicit and executable.
rule_mapping.notes: Evidence and runtime-gating signals are checked; DTS/schema correctness is not re-validated.

rule_mapping.rule_summary: Runtime-sensitive decisions must remain fail-closed until evidence artifacts explicitly unblock them.
rule_mapping.notes: Runtime-sensitive fail-closed policy check is implemented against blocker artifacts.

limitations: Vendor elimination and runtime-claim checks are heuristic scans and may produce false positives/negatives.
Checker surfaces existing derivation risk from artifacts; it does not recompute full similarity scoring.
Runtime-evidence detection is artifact-name based and does not validate evidence quality.
Lineage check tolerates schema variation and therefore reports inferred coverage only.
Prototype does not modify canonical gate/scorer/verifier verdicts.
